scope: Read-only independent audit of saved experiment 148 v4 results; no experiments, services, model calls, or original artifacts changed.

collection_evolution_70.interpretation: The saved trajectory learner inputs preserve public utterances, calls and error/success returns; low-reward and error-bearing collection material is widespread, not confined to task 0. The trajectory converter's 4000-character per-tool cap is present but did not truncate any actual tool result in this collection. Timeout/too_many_errors are saved native termination labels; 15 such cases have reward 0 with null reward_breakdown, so they are not evidence of completed DB/NL checks failing or proof of a pure model failure. Their detailed failure mechanisms and infrastructure causes are not established by these labels alone.

paired.deterministic_bootstrap_note: Dynamic convolution of the empirical task-level quarter-delta distribution for 40 independent draws; same percentile bootstrap target as the reported Monte Carlo procedure, not a new experiment or a parametric CI.

posthoc_no_shared_train_order_subset.qualification: Supplementary posthoc descriptive cut based on saved train-order overlap audit. Shared domain/policy/database persist; this is not an OOD or causal-generalization proof. Train-overlap definition was not independently recomputed from private gold material in this audit.

split_checks.scope: Structural ID disjointness only; does not establish order, task-family, user, or semantic isolation.

current_skill_freeze_checks.interpretation: All current content equals the saved manifest after removing CRLF conversion. Current checkout is not byte-identical to the Linux freeze; this does not show the original experiment changed its skills during evaluation.

mapping_limitations: Current checkout does not contain runs/autoskill_library session artifacts needed by the original matcher.
Saved audit records omit prompt epoch and explicit simulation-to-session mapping, so the 160 final matches cannot be independently reconstructed here.
Original matcher picks nearest prompt mtime within 300 seconds without imposing one-to-one matching or recording alternate candidate gaps.

Scan defines reads from calls or results by skill path; its triggered predicate is bool(read_skills). It does not check read-tool success, nonempty full returned body, content hash, or whether all requested skills fit in the read/context budget.

The direct sample verifier also checks toolCall and SKILL.md path presence, not successful full body delivery. The defensible saved-audit claim is attempted native skill consultation, not verified full-text consumption in all 159 sessions.
Final report and memory quote an older 188-reference/172-read snapshot; saved audit JSON currently reports 206/190. These denominators must be version-labeled.

methods_and_limitations: Exact McNemar p is twice the lower Binomial(32, 0.5) tail at 12; numerically identical to the run-pair exact sign test for binary rewards.
The 160 run-pairs are nested in 40 tasks. Nominal run-level McNemar independence is not assured; task-cluster intervals and task-level summaries must accompany it.
All-four reliability is pass^4: mean choose(successes,4)/choose(4,4). At-least-one success is pass@4; both groups have 39/40, a different quantity.

Nonterminal user messages exclude any message containing STOP, TRANSFER, or OUT-OF-SCOPE terminal markers; initial user message is included in the first count and removed once per simulation in the second.
Business tool counts use tau2 AssistantMessage.tool_calls and corresponding tool replies. They exclude local skill reads and raw model call counts.

Explicit tool error counts use Error: or Error prefix, or a nonempty JSON error field; independently checked saved native ToolMessage.error=true counts agree exactly at B0=23 and B1=38. They describe explicit environment errors, not all possible semantic errors.
Only user-simulator usage is stored in result messages; assistant usage is entirely null. The stored user token sums are partial costs, not total B0/B1 experiment tokens.
Message cost fields are 0.0 in stored proxy results, while agent_cost and user_cost are null. Actual paid/free monetary cost is unknown, never inferred as zero.
Base seed is 42 and the two groups' per-task/trial seeds agree in all 160 pairs; raw per-simulation seeds use the native runner's generated values, not the stale experiment.yaml formula 42+trial.
The experiment uses one base seed, one held-out same-domain test split, one frozen skill bank and API model aliases; extrapolation to other libraries/models/enterprise deployment is unsupported.
Version changes include conversation-to-trajectory learning, GLM-to-DeepSeek consumer/user switch, B1-only explicit native skill references, and judge parsing/retry adaptations.
Claims that prompts are identical or skills directory is the only change omit B1's consult-skills prompt intervention. The treatment is library plus instructed consultation.
run_test_phase_v4.sh requests concurrency 8 per group, potentially 16 total; the B1 resume script requests 12. Reported maximum 12 requires runtime evidence, not this script alone.

Current protocol, experiment.yaml, and versions.json retain preparation-stage settings/status and only dev_frozen_p1/p2/p4 directories are present. Actual v4 setting evidence comes from result metadata, scripts, skill manifest and later memory; independent complete v4/v6 source freeze is not established by this checkout.

Reported infrastructure recovery and prior test-visible revisions make the result exploratory. All surviving 320 rows terminate normally, but absence of null reward in surviving rows alone does not establish a failure-free or selection-free attempt history.
Earlier negative and broken-treatment batches must remain separately visible. New positive point estimates cannot retroactively overwrite them or establish a causal skill improvement.
